content.passage: Mai and Anna go shopping. Mai wants to buy a gift for her mother. At the first shop, there is a beautiful red dress. "How much is it?" Mai asks. "Nine hundred thousand dong." It is too expensive! They go to the market. A woman sells nice bags. "This black bag is on sale," she says. "Two hundred thousand dong." Mai likes it. She pays in cash. "Your mother will love it," Anna says.
content.question: Who goes shopping with Mai?

guideText:
Mẫu câu chính: "How much is this dress?" (Cái váy này bao nhiêu tiền?) — "Can I pay by card?" (Tôi trả bằng thẻ được không?) — "It is on sale." (Nó đang giảm giá.)
How much is + số ít / How much are + số nhiều: "How much are the shoes?"
"Shoes" luôn ở dạng số nhiều (một đôi giày = a pair of shoes).
Màu sắc đứng trước danh từ: "a red dress" (một cái váy đỏ). Hỏi màu: "What color is it?"
Trả tiền: pay in cash (tiền mặt) / pay by card (bằng thẻ). "Expensive" (đắt) ↔ "cheap" (rẻ).
